_comment: Bauer MCP gateway config. TEMPLATE ONLY — copy to /data/company/mcp_servers.json on the volume and fill real values there. Never commit secrets to this file. Rationale is recorded in Bauer's internal tracker, not in this public repo.
_secrets_note: The gateway forwards only the env vars named in orchestrator/mcp_gateway.py::_FORWARDED_ENV_VARS to the extensible-mcp child. MS365_*, ZOHO_* and GITHUB_* are NOT in that list, so $VAR interpolation will NOT resolve for them. Put literal values in the copy on /data (never committed) rather than editing _FORWARDED_ENV_VARS — that is an upstream file and editing it is a permanent merge tax.

m365_graph._status: VERIFIED — flags, presets and counts read from 3P-ms-365-mcp-server@70a54bc
m365_graph._note: --org-mode is required for Teams tools. Pin a version rather than floating on latest for a production service; the fork exists so we control when upstream lands.
m365_graph._read_only: --read-only is a TOOL-SURFACE filter, not a runtime guard: dropped tools never appear in tools/list. It removes every non-GET endpoint, keeping 7 POST-shaped reads plus the 4 utility tools. It also drops graph-batch (a POST with no readOnly flag); no flag keeps batching while dropping the other writes. A consumer that needs batching runs without it.
m365_graph._sharepoint_exclusion: SharePoint is served by different tooling, so it is excluded here. No preset can express that: there is no sharepoint preset, and those 34 tools sit inside the work preset alongside Teams. --enabled-tools compiles as new RegExp(pattern, 'i') against toolName, so negative lookahead works. Verified: keeps 298 of 332 endpoint tools, zero SharePoint leaking. Not shell-quoted because args are exec'd directly.
m365_graph._pin_me: PIN_ME cannot be resolved by reading the fork: its package.json says version 0.0.0-development because semantic-release stamps the real version at publish time. Resolve with `npm view @softeria/ms-365-mcp-server versions` and pin explicitly.

zoho._status: UNVERIFIED — do not enable until confirmed
zoho._confirm: Zoho's MCP is a hosted remote endpoint (mcp.zoho.com). Unknown whether extensible-mcp (git+https://github.com/SenteLabsAI/extensible-mcp) accepts remote URL servers or stdio only — the shipped example shows stdio only, and that package was not inspected. If stdio only, a stdio-to-HTTP bridge is needed and the exact command must be confirmed before use rather than guessed.
zoho._covers: Zoho CRM, Books, Desk. Float Financial spend arrives already inside Books via zoho-float-sync, so Float needs no entry.
